title: 白宫经济顾问：50基点加息预期升温，市场准备好了吗？
speaker: Chris Falen

segments.en: But if we're seeing the energy you know complex start to roll over if prices really are start to move lower And you know that inflation comps also get more difficulties you move forward You know perhaps their inflation will start to slow and perhaps even growth starts to slow on a rate of change basis moving forward
segments.zh: 但如果能源这块开始回落，价格真的走低，通胀比较基数也变得更难，往后看，通胀可能会开始放缓，甚至增长按变化率算也会放缓。

segments.en: Let's talk about what the Fed I mean it seems like it's quite rare I feel we hear from Fed officials talking about the possibility of a 50 basis point hike
segments.zh: 我们来谈谈美联储，感觉很少听到美联储官员谈论加息50个基点的可能性。

segments.en: I mean how real is that possibility you think now?
segments.zh: 你觉得现在这种可能性有多大？

segments.en: Yeah I mean market markets are now fully priced as you mentioned you know that that hike in December And you know are now pricing at least two hikes by by March and perhaps even more
segments.zh: 是的，市场现在已经完全定价了你提到的12月加息，而且至少定价了到3月前两次加息，甚至可能更多。

segments.en: I think perhaps with those comments and we've seen it continue this morning Fed speakers schools being and Paul some both kind of reading from the same hawkish playbook
segments.zh: 我觉得可能通过这些评论，今早我们也看到美联储发言人继续鹰派，都像是从同一本鹰派剧本里读出来的。

segments.en: I think they wanted to draw the line we've seen you know pricing on that Fed hike in December and further really start to slip And start here discussions of maybe it's a one and done maybe doesn't happen December
segments.zh: 我认为他们想划清界限，我们看到12月加息的定价开始下滑，并开始讨论可能一次就结束，12月不加息。

segments.en: I think they wanted to draw the line there whether they actually follow through on a jumbo hike I think at this point the market's not leaning in that direction but perhaps we can move further there
segments.zh: 我认为他们想在那里划清界限，无论他们是否真的跟进大幅加息，目前市场并不倾向那个方向，但也许我们可以进一步。
